CustomField.description: Per-section flag read by Form_Submission_Convert_Upsert_Contact_Overridable (Switch_Add_to_Account on PageSection.Add_to_Account__c). When true, the converted Contact for this section is associated to the Account produced by conversion. Use to control whether each section's Contact is linked to the Account.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Turn on so the Contact created from this section is linked to the converted Account. Leave off if this section's Contact should not be added to the Account.
CustomField.label: Add to Account
